title: EPANET
description: Documented public water distribution modeling (US EPA (open source)) for the Water Systems Simulator capability area.
body:
EPANET is a documented water distribution modeling from US EPA (open source). The EPA's public-domain software modeling water distribution hydraulics and quality — the global standard for pipe networks.

How it works: It works by evaluating the Hazen-Williams equation for head loss from flow, length, diameter, and roughness coefficient.

Documented uses of this capability area include city digital twins, power-grid planning, water-network operations, epidemic modeling, and disaster early warning.
